meta.title: Meetnote | AI meeting assistant that writes the notes
meta.description: Meetnote records meetings, writes a clear summary, and turns decisions into action items with owners and dates.

hero.title: Leave every meeting with notes already written
hero.subtitle: Meetnote records the call, writes a summary of what was decided, and lists the action items with an owner and a date.
hero.proof: Sample meeting summary with demo data
hero.mockCaption: Demo data. Names and notes are samples.

problem.title: The meeting ends. The notes never arrive
problem.text: Someone promises to write up the call, then the day moves on. Decisions fade, owners forget, and the next meeting starts by repeating the last one.

benefits.title: Notes you can trust, minutes after the call
benefits.subtitle: Four things Meetnote does for every meeting.

items.title: Recording that respects the room
items.text: Meetnote joins with a clear notice, records the call, and keeps the audio available to the people who were there.

items.title: Summaries in plain language
items.text: Decisions, open questions, and disagreements each get their own line, so the summary reads in two minutes.

items.title: Action items with owners
items.text: Every task from the call gets a name and a date, and the list goes to the team right after the meeting.

items.title: Works where you meet
items.text: Connects to your calendar and your video calls, so notes land in the same place your team already works.

tagline: Talk through the meeting. The summary, the decisions, and the next steps are already written.

steps.title: How Meetnote works
steps.subtitle: Three steps from invite to summary.

items.title: Connect your calendar
items.text: Meetnote sees your upcoming calls and asks which ones to join. Nothing is recorded without the room knowing.

items.title: Meet as usual
items.text: Talk normally. Meetnote records, follows who said what, and marks the moments that sound like decisions.

items.title: Get the summary
items.text: Minutes after the call, the summary and action items arrive in your inbox and in your team workspace.

items.q: Does everyone in the meeting know it is recorded?
items.a: Yes. Meetnote joins visibly and announces the recording at the start, and the host can stop it at any time.

items.q: Which video tools does it work with?
items.a: Common video call platforms and calendars. The supported list is published on the integrations page.
Summaries quote the decisions and action items from the transcript. You can edit any line, and the recording stays linked for checking.
Yes. Meetnote records and summarises meetings in Arabic and English, including mixed language calls.
Only the people invited to the meeting, unless the host shares it more widely. Recordings are deleted on the schedule you choose.

items.q: Can I correct an action item?
items.a: Yes. Edit the owner or the date in the summary, and the change updates everywhere the list was shared.
Yes. The trial includes Starter features and needs no credit card.

items.q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
items.a: Your summaries and recordings stay available until the end of the paid period, and you can export them before the account closes.

final.title: Stop writing notes after the call
final.text: Start a free trial and get your next meeting summary without lifting a pen.
final.note: No credit card needed. Cancel anytime.
